title: Japan 30-Year JGB auction (¥600bn anticipated, reopening of issue 91) — the other leg of the 30s40s spread that has collapsed to its 1.7th percentile
source: EST: mof.go.jp English October 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2610e.htm), fetched direct 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 24,853 bytes) by the jgb-40y-auction-2026-09-29 initial research, whose table row reads 'Oct. 8, 2026 | 30-year'. The issue amount is blank on the calendar because MOF's own note on that page states 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date' — so the ~2026-10-01 announcement is the confirming primary, not this page. The ¥600bn anticipated size and the reopening read come from a second MOF primary, the Auction Results for JGBs workbook (english/policy/jgbs/auction/past_auction_results/Auction_Results_for_JGBs.xls, downloaded and parsed 2026-09-08): the 30-year runs monthly, MOF cut it from ¥700bn to ¥600bn effective 2026-04-07, and issue 91 (4.0% coupon, maturity 2056-06-20) was first sold 2026-07-07 at ¥600bn. Unlike the 40-year, the 30-year IS a multiple-price auction and does report a tail (2026-07-07: 3.993% average vs 3.996% lowest accepted, a 0.3bp tail). Filed `estimate` on the same two counts every JGB entry on this calendar records: the size is anticipated rather than announced, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: Discovered during the jgb-40y-auction-2026-09-29 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-08) on MOF's own October calendar, which was fetched to test whether the 40-year is bi-monthly — it is, and October carries no 40-year at all. It earns a slot on one term: the 40-year ledger's load-bearing measurement is that the 30s40s spread has collapsed to +0.4bp (2026-09-07), the 1.7th percentile of 4,606 sessions since 2007-11-06, having printed -11.1bp on 2026-07-02. That spread has two legs and this calendar tracked neither 30-year side of it. 2026-10-08 is where the 30-year leg gets repriced by its own supply, nine days after the 40-year clears, and it is the nearest super-long JGB coupon auction after 09-29 (MOF's next 40-year is November; the only other October super-long supply is a Liquidity Enhancement Auction for remaining maturities of 11-39 years on 2026-10-27). It also lands one week after boj-summary-of-opinions-2026-10-01 and boj-tankan-2026-10-01, both already tracked. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low` on the evidence the 40-year ledger measured at the neighbouring tenor: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure, and the JGB-super-long-auction-to-US-long-end spillover is a null whose sign does not hold across samples (n=94, t = -1.45 full sample; n=22, t = +1.08 since 2023). Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
